items.title: File Widerspruch against accident recognition decision
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde, Widerspruch erheben.
items.computation: Letter is dated Fri 20.11.2026 and gives no separate 'zur Post gegeben' date, so the posting day is 20.11.2026. The sender is a statutory accident insurance carrier (gesetzliche Unfallversicherung), a social-law body under SGB VII/SGB X, so § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X applies: deemed delivery is the 4th day after posting, counting calendar days (20.11.→21.,22.,23.,24.), giving Tue 24.11.2026. For social-law bodies (unlike tax offices) this delivery day does NOT move even onto a weekend/holiday, but 24.11.2026 is a Tuesday anyway. The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG) runs from this deemed delivery date; per § 187 Abs. 1 / § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, a one-month period starting with an event ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the day of delivery, i.e. 24.12.2026. 24 December is a statutory working day (per the applicable rules) and falls on a Thursday in 2026, so no weekend/holiday shift applies.
